interpretation: This is an honest FAIL, not a fabricated PASS and not an environment-blocked result. The build got substantially further than before (past the memory-exhaustion point that blocked the prior session) and failed for a legitimate, already-known, out-of-scope code reason: Next.js's own build-time type-check does not scope itself to only the files a route actually needs at runtime - it checks the whole tsconfig 'include' set, so any pre-existing error anywhere in the repo (even in code Council never touches) blocks 'next build' for the whole app. 'pnpm exec tsc --noEmit' and the 10/11-validator suite both independently confirm the Council-scoped code itself is clean.
would_a_fix_be_in_scope: No. Fixing this would require either (a) editing the pre-existing lib/modular-intelligence/*.validation.ts type error, which is explicitly forbidden WRIM/Native-Router-adjacent code, or (b) changing next.config.ts/tsconfig.json build behavior (e.g. typescript.ignoreBuildErrors), which is a project-wide policy change outside this mission's authorization and was not requested. Recorded as a real, honest build blocker instead.
